ITEM 1 | Scrambled egg-like mass, pale yellow with orange-tinged streaks, soft and fluffy with curds, moist sheen, spread across the lower-left half of the plate, roughly 40% of plate area, about 2 cm tall in clumps | 130
ITEM 2 | Cubes of orange-fleshed roasted root vegetable, about 2 cm pieces, caramelized edges with golden-brown patches, slightly glossy, scattered across the upper-middle of the plate, roughly 15% of plate area, about 1.5 cm tall | 85
ITEM 3 | Brownish-tan cubes with darker browned crust, about 2 cm, firm-looking, dry surface, one larger piece near the top-right edge of the plate | 30
ITEM 4 | Fresh strawberry halves and slices, bright red with pale white core, glossy wet surface, sliced into wedges about 3 cm long, located on the right edge of the plate, roughly 12% of plate area | 65
ITEM 5 | Small dark blueberries, about 1 cm diameter, glossy dark blue skin, two visible, one near the top center and one at the lower-center edge of the eggs | 4
ITEM 6 | Red juice or light sauce smear, thin reddish-pink stain along the upper-right rim and near strawberries, watery and translucent | 5
